The largest planet is the one that is the loudest. I can hear it from the meadow, a deep, rolling call that echoes through the trees. It is not the one that calls in the dark, but the one that calls in the day, when the light is strong and the wind is still. I do not know its name, but I know it is far away, and it is the one that makes the most noise. I do not need to know its name. I only need to know that it is the largest. Hoo... hoo-hoo-hooo.
